required_acceptance: Reject wrong or missing source, owner, authority, and event provenance in every materialized commitment; main constraints must expose source and priority
Reject replacement or cancellation of a pending goal already witnessed complete
Require exactly the witnessed retained milestone; reject missing, empty, false, wrong-ID, or fabricated progress
Require event ID, current world version, and actual input state revision; reject missing, stale, future, or mismatched evidence
For replacement require exactly the pending replacement step with correct object, target, skill, status, and dependency; reject obsolete or empty plans
Require unique correctly typed entities for retained, pending, replacement, and target region roles
Require predicate and canonical object-region grounding for every commitment in replacement and cancellation
Reject duplicate as well as missing, extra, or stale current-goal atoms
Reject restoration work not authorized by the event and common recovery input
Reject every schema other than the single versioned canonical full-state representation
Reject a nonterminal rewrite with zero task commitments
Require stable lineage for every rewritten commitment and validate continuity against the previous state
Ignore provider controller prose in both arms and compile only the accepted canonical state through one versioned compiler
